sites.name: Black Oak Group Campground
sites.feeText: There are four group sites at this facility: . Unit #1 = $135/night, 50 people maximum, No trailers. Unit #2 = $145/night, 75 people maximum, Self-contained vehicles only. Unit #3 = $135/night, 50 people maximum, No…
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Black Oak Campground is group camping destination near Stumpy Meadows Lake on the Eldorado National Forest. The forest boasts over 400 miles of hiking trails and an abundance of lakes and rivers for fishing and swimming.
sites.directions: 21 miles east of Georgetown on Wentworth Springs Road.
sites.restrictions: In units 1, 3, & 4, all vehicles must be kept in the unit’s central parking area. No trailers are allowed because of the difficulty of getting trailers in and out of these areas. Please keep family pets on a leash at all times. Please use the stove or fire ring provided and make sure your fire is…
sites.reservations: Reservations are required. Call 1-877-444-6777 or go to Recreation.gov. Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and Discover accepted. Interagency Senior/Access/Annual passes do not apply to Group facilities.

sites.name: Stumpy Meadows Campground
sites.feeText: $28/ single site. $56/ double site. $28/overnight camp on the boatramp. $10/day use. Other fees: Dumping waste tank and extra vehicle fees = $10.00.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Stumpy Meadows, on the Stumpy Meadows Reservoir, provides an enjoyable setting in a heavy conifer forest with easy access to an array of water activities. Campers come here to while away warm summer days on the lake and enjoy the sights and sounds of the great outdoors. The campground provides…
sites.directions: From Placerville take Hwy 49 N for 1/2 mile, turn right on Hwy 193 to Georgetown. Take a right on main street in Georgetown and proceed 15 miles to the campground. From Auburn, Take Hwy 49 S to…
sites.restrictions: Please check with the campground attendant or entrance board before setting up your camp. Please keep family pets on a leash at all times. sites.reservations: Call 1-877-444-6777 or go to Website: Recreation.gov. Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and Discover accepted. Give your Interagency Senior or Access number when making a reservation.

sites.name: Ponderosa Cove Group Campground
sites.feeText: $175/ group of 75 people. There are also fees for extra vehicle, pets, and wood is available for purchase from host. 5 vehicle spurs and a parking area for 10 vehicles.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Ponderosa Cove greets group campers with shaded campsites close to scenic Stumpy Meadows Reservoir. The campground provides a pleasant destination for bird watching and nature viewing, in addition to activities at the lake.
sites.directions: 17 miles east of Georgetown on Wentworth Springs road. East of the dam on the north side of the road.
sites.restrictions: Please check with the campground attendant or entrance board before setting up your camp. Please keep family pets on a leash at all times. Use only dead and down wood for your campfires. Make sure your fire is dead out before leaving. Check ahead. Campfires may not be allowed during. Check out…
sites.reservations: CALL 1-877-444-6777, four days to 360 days in advance of your first night’s stay. Recreation.gov. Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and Discover accepted.

sites.name: West Point Campground
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: West Point Campground is located on the northwest shore of Union Valley reservoir off of North Union Valley Road. There are 22 sites ranging from single to triple in capacity. There is a boat ramp with access to the reservoir. The campground and boat ramp are at 4,875 feet in elevation.

sites.reservations: No Reservations. Sites are available on a first-come,first-served basis.

sites.name: Camino Cove Campground
sites.feeText: No fees are required for this site
sites.about: Elevation 4,875'. 32 units. Vault toilets, fire rings. No water, grills or tables. No Fee. Check ahead - campfires may not be allowed during fire restrictions.
sites.directions: Located on northwest shore of Union Valley Reservoir, 17 miles from Highway 50. From Highway 50 go 7 miles north on Ice House Road. Turn left on Peavine Ridge Road, go 3 miles west to Bryant Springs…
sites.reservations: No Reservations. Sites are available on a first-come,first-served basis.

sites.name: Dru Barner Campground
sites.about: Dru Barner Campground offers 48 campsites that are nestled in the forest just 6 miles from Georgetown, CA. The campground offers access to trails, creeks and is a short drive from some nearby reservoirs. This campground was designed for equestrians, but it can also be used by tent, camper, trailer…
sites.directions: 7.5 miles east of Georgetown on Wentworth Springs Road (Forest Road 1), then 1 mile north east on Forest Road 13N16 and 0.5 miles northwest on Forest Road 13N58.
sites.restrictions: Please keep family pets on a leash at all times. Please use the metal fire rings provided. A campfire permit is required for fires at units without established fire rings. Make sure your fire is dead out before leaving. Check out time is 1:00 p.m. Check ahead. Campfires may not be allowed during…
sites.reservations: CALL 1-877-444-6777, four days to 6 months in advance of your first night’s stay. WEBSITE: Recreation.gov. Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and Discover accepted.

sites.name: Wolf Creek Group Campground
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Wolf Creek Campground is a modern facility on the north shore of Union Valley Reservoir. The reservoir offers plenty of opportunities for water activities like sailing, boating, swimming and fishing. Bring a bike to explore the neighboring bike trail. Eldorado National Forest includes the famed…
sites.directions: 23 miles east of Placerville on Highway 50 then 19 miles north on Ice House Road (Forest Road 3) then 2 miles west on Forest Road 12N78 on the north side of Union Valley Reservoir.
sites.reservations: CALL 1-877-444-6777, four days to 6 months in advance of your first night’s stay. Recreation.gov. Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and Discover accepted. Both reservation and first-come, first-served sites available.

sites.name: Robbs Hut
sites.about: Robbs Hut offers a peaceful, rustic getaway with phenomenal views of the Sierra Nevada. The cozy, yet minimalistic cabin is open year-round and can be accessed by car in warmer months. From November to mid-June, guests can expect to hike, snowshoe or ski up a 3-mile trail with a 1,000-foot…
sites.directions: Check in is done in person at the Placerville Ranger Station 4260 Eight Mile Rd., Camino Ca. 95709.

sites.name: Sunset Campground
sites.feeText: $28/single. $56/double. $84/triple. $28/camping on boatramp (overflow only). $145/group 30-person site. $10/boatramp day use . Other fees: $10 dumping waste tank, extra vehicle . Wood is available for purchase from host.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Sunset Campground is situated on the shores of Union Valley Reservoir, among the towering cedar and ponderosa pines of Eldorado National Forest. Aptly named, the campground is a fantastic destination for colorful sunset views over the lake. All water activities are popular here, but it's also fun…
sites.directions: 23 miles east of Placerville on Highway 50 then 14 miles north on Ice House Road (Forest Road 3) on the east side of Union Valley Reservoir.
sites.reservations: CALL 1-877-444-6777, four days to 6 months in advance of your first night’s stay. Recreation.gov. Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and Discover accepted. Both reservation and first-come, first-served sites available.

sites.name: Fashoda Campground
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Fashoda Campground, located on a peninsula of the eastern side of Union Valley Reservoir, is an incredibly scenic place to camp. The lake area is a hub for activities like swimming, sailing, boating and fishing. Hiking and biking are also quite popular, and many campers make use of the Union…
sites.directions: 23 miles east of Placerville and 15 miles north on Ice House Road (Forest Road 3).
sites.reservations: No Reservations. Sites are available on a first-come,first-served basis.

sites.name: South Fork Group Campground
sites.about: South Fork is the largest group campground in the Crystal Basin Recreation Area, nestled in the vast expanse of the Eldorado National Forest. The remote location affords visitors a true outdoor camping experience.
sites.directions: 23 miles east of Placerville on Highway 50 and 23 miles north on Ice House Road (Forest Road 3) then (left) 0.5 miles on Forest Road 13N28.
sites.reservations: Available by reservation only (summer). CALL 1-877-444-6777, four days to 360 days in advance of your first night’s stay. Recreation.gov. Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and Discover accepted.
